# Class: `LinkedGraphicsView`

Reports changes to image position and zoom so the other panes can follow them.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-viewer.md) · [Source](../src/icescopy_viewer.py#L65) · [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `QGraphicsView`.

`content_rect` stores the actual image bounds. The scrollable scene has extra space so each pane can center the same image point near an edge. Pass `content_rect`, rather than the expanded scene rectangle, when fitting the image. `cameraChanged` and `viewportResized` identify the view whose transform or size changed.
